title: Amazing Fantasy
description: The anthology series that introduced Spider-Man in issue #15 (1962), written by Stan Lee and drawn by Steve Ditko.

title: The Amazing Spider-Man
description: The original Amazing Spider-Man ongoing series running from 1963 to 1998 across 441 issues, spanning Stan Lee through Tom DeFalco.

title: The Amazing Spider-Man (Vol. 2)
description: The relaunched Amazing Spider-Man volume covering the Howard Mackie, JMS, and Dan Slott eras through issue #700.

title: The Amazing Spider-Man (Vol. 3)
description: A short volume bridging the Superior Spider-Man era back to Peter Parker, written by Dan Slott.

title: The Amazing Spider-Man (Vol. 4)
description: Dan Slott's final Amazing Spider-Man volume, culminating in the landmark #800 and Go Down Swinging.

title: The Amazing Spider-Man (Vol. 5)
description: Nick Spencer's run restoring Peter Parker's classic status quo, featuring Sins Rising, Last Remains, and Beyond.

title: Peter Parker, the Spectacular Spider-Man
description: The long-running companion to Amazing Spider-Man featuring Kraven's Last Hunt and many classic supporting stories.

title: Spectacular Spider-Man
description: A short-lived revival of the Spectacular Spider-Man title in the early 2000s.

title: Web of Spider-Man
description: A companion Spider-Man series running from 1985 to 1995, featuring many crossover tie-in issues.

title: Spider-Man
description: Todd McFarlane's self-titled Spider-Man series launched in 1990, later continuing with other creative teams.

title: Superior Spider-Man
description: Dan Slott's bold experiment with Otto Octavius as the Superior Spider-Man, replacing Peter Parker for 33 issues.

title: Untold Tales of Spider-Man
description: Kurt Busiek's series telling untold stories set during Spider-Man's early career, filling in gaps from the Lee/Ditko era.

title: Marvel Team-Up
description: Spider-Man teams up with a different Marvel hero each issue across this long-running anthology series.

title: Spider-Man vs. Wolverine
description: A two-issue prestige format series pitting Spider-Man against Wolverine in a Cold War thriller.

title: Batman: Year One
description: Frank Miller and David Mazzucchelli's definitive Batman origin story, originally published in Batman #404-407.

title: Invincible
description: Robert Kirkman and Ryan Ottley's superhero epic following Mark Grayson, son of the world's greatest hero.

title: Hellboy
description: Mike Mignola's iconic Dark Horse series following Hellboy, a demon raised by the BPRD to fight supernatural threats.

title: Ultimate Spider-Man (2000)
description: Brian Michael Bendis and Mark Bagley's landmark Ultimate Spider-Man series modernizing Peter Parker's origin and running 160 issues.

title: Ultimate Spider-Man (2024)
description: Jonathan Hickman's revival of Ultimate Spider-Man featuring a married 35-year-old Peter Parker in a new Ultimate Universe.

title: Batman
description: The original Batman ongoing series running from 1940 to 2011, spanning the Golden Age through modern era across 713 issues.

title: Batman (New 52)
description: Scott Snyder and Greg Capullo's acclaimed New 52 Batman run featuring Court of Owls, Death of the Family, Zero Year, and Endgame.

title: Batman (Rebirth)
description: The ongoing DC Rebirth Batman series beginning with Tom King's run, continuing through James Tynion IV and Chip Zdarsky.

title: Detective Comics
description: Batman's home series since Detective Comics #27 (1939). The longest-running superhero comic in history.

title: Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight
description: Anthology series featuring self-contained Batman stories set across different periods of his career.

title: Batman: Shadow of the Bat
description: An ongoing Batman series that played a key role in the Knightfall and No Man's Land crossovers.

title: Batman Eternal
description: Weekly Batman series featuring a massive conspiracy threatening Gotham, with Gordon framed for murder.
